`GeoLite2-City-Test.mmdb` is MaxMind's small synthetic reader fixture, downloaded
from https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/blob/main/test-data/GeoLite2-City-Test.mmdb
on 12 November 2026. It is not a production GeoLite download. The upstream
repository offers the MIT or Apache 2.0 license; the MIT license is included.
